title: Santa Cruz civic strike and distributed blockade-point reporting
location: Santa Cruz department; reports describe distributed urban/provincial points, not a single attendance site.
reason: A civic work stoppage and multiple blockade points are reported, but neither work stoppage nor number of sites provides a simultaneous gathering attendance count. Do not aggregate blockade points as a crowd.
limitations: Could be a separate eligible crowd event if a specific gathering with 50+ is documented; this record is excluded from event count pending evidence, not a claim that no protest occurred.
